UPDATE heartbeat_checks SET
                last_ping_at = MAX(COALESCE(last_ping_at, 0), ?),
                failed = 0,
                paused_until = CASE
                    WHEN pause_until_ping = 1 AND paused_until > ? THEN ?
                    ELSE paused_until END,
                pause_until_ping = 0
              WHERE id = ?
